Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
If my grandpredator bleeds my predator, and he bounces the bleed to me
(thereby implicitly declaring "no block"), and I play Two Wrongs, does
another blocking window open for my predator? I would assume yes,
since Two Wrongs doesn't actually cancel the first bleed redirection
card, but wanted to check to make sure.

Two Wrongs
Master: out-of-turn. Trifle.
Play when a minion controlled by a Methuselah other than your predator
is bleeding you. That minion is now bleeding his or her prey. The next
card that would change the target of this bleed is canceled as it is
played.

John Eno

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:


Two wrongs changes the target of the bleed. When the target of a bleed
changes, a new blocking opportunity is created.

-witness1
